## Python in Practice

In a previous course, I used Python and SQL to analyze business data, including sales trends and performance. Here is a simple example of using Python to summarize monthly sales:

```{python}
monthly_sales = [12500, 14800, 13200, 15600, 17100]
average_sales = sum(monthly_sales) / len(monthly_sales)

print(f"Average Monthly Sales: ${average_sales:,.2f}")
```
